{{Top|leg}}
'''Oysters''' were a species of [[Mollusk/Legends|mollusk]] that inhabited the [[Water/Legends|water]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]]. They were eaten by the native [[Sedrian]]s as [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], and were sold in the local marketplace in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Fitsay]].<ref name="BGS">''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''</ref>

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The phrase "[[Rimbaux Four]] was my oyster" was mentioned in the short story "[[Musings of an Ithorian]]," which was included in the [[1993]] book ''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]'', a publication that combines creature designs and photographs from various projects of [[George Lucas]], creator of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' franchise, with original text by [[Bob Carrau]].<ref name="Monsters">{{StoryCite|story=Musings of an Ithorian|book=Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas}}</ref> [[Lucasfilm]] employee [[Leland Chee]], who maintains the [[Holocron continuity database]], has indicated that information contained in ''Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas'' is [[Canon|non-canonical]] with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Chee">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=690#14724917|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-05-03|time=5:45 PM|quote=And is information from Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas canon? Unless referred to by a source that is in-continuity, the information is non-continuity.}}</ref>
